items.what: 입력 의존적 sparse attention routing을 동적으로 수행, structural proxy로 routing 오버헤드 제거.
items.relation: H2와 관련. 장문 맥락에서 attention의 O(S²)를 sparse화하려 하는데, H2의 '단문에서 MLP가 병목'과는 다른 범위.
items.gap: 대상 맥락 InfiniteBench/RULER(128K+) vs 우리 환경(0.5~4K); sparse overhead 고려 vs H2의 'MLP 병목' 관찰.
hypothesis_notes: H2: S ≤ 4K 구간에서는 attention의 O(S²) 항이 지배적이지 않고 MLP/projection이 병목
items.title: CRISP: Cliff-awaRe Input-adaptive Sparse Prefilling with Structural-Mass-Motivated Routing
items.abstract: The attention prefilling phase of long-context LLM inference scales quadratically, making self-attention a severe computational bottleneck. Traditional sparse attention methods mitigate this through fixed patterns or offline profiling, but lack the flexibility to adapt to input-dependent attention structure. Recent dynamic methods address this by routing heads to sparse patterns in real-time, but rely on indirect routing proxies with overhead and budget allocation mechanisms that overlook the post-softmax mass hierarchy. We present CRISP (Cliff-awaRe Input-adaptive Sparse Prefilling), which id

items.what: NPU-NDP 협력으로 MoE batched 추론 가속, 데이터 이동 비용과 통신-연산 오버랩을 분석 모델에 포함.
items.relation: H5와 관련. 통신-연산 오버랩 설계 및 expert 스케줄링을 다루며, H5의 'overlap zero-sum 구간' 문제와 유사.
items.gap: NPU-NDP 이원 체제 vs CPU-only; batched 높은 처리량 추론 vs single-stream TTFT 중심.
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
H5: CPU 코어가 4개뿐이라 통신 스레드와 GEMM이 경합, overlap이 zero-sum이 되는 구간이 존재한다
items.title: DynaNDE: Dynamic Near-Data Expert Scheduling for Batched MoE Inference
items.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language model (LLM) inference but suffer from substantial data-movement overhead when deployed on neural processing unit (NPU)-based systems. Near-Data Processing (NDP) provides a promising way to mitigate this bottleneck via cooperative NPU-NDP execution. However, existing NPU-NDP MoE systems do not fully account for hardware heterogeneity, dynamic expert-level concurrency, and temporal expert reuse during batched inference. This paper presents DynaNDE, a dynamic near-data expert scheduling framework that exploits NPU-NDP coll

items.what: 광전자 고대역 상호연결로 MoE prefill을 가속, 단문(1K-8K)~장문(1M) 시뮬레이션에서 2.1~5.8배 지연 개선.
items.relation: H1의 '통신이 prefill 병목'을 입증한다. 사용자는 H1에 기반해 '통신 최적화 폐기' 결정했으므로 이 논문은 버린 방향의 증거.
items.gap: GPU 기반 고대역 네트워크(광전자) vs 1GbE CPU 클러스터; 통신 최적화 노선 vs 사용자의 '연산 축 집중' 전략.
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
items.title: Scaling Inference Prefill with High-Radix Photonic Interconnects
items.abstract: With the rise of inference as today's dominant AI workload, the industry is transitioning to high-bandwidth photonic interconnects to meet the large scale-up requirements of increasingly complex Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. This paper quantifies the benefits of 3D-integrated photonic interconnects for inference prefill by analyzing tradeoffs between high-concurrency throughput for Large Language Model (LLM) chat and the large context windows typically required for reasoning and agentic AI. all.what: block-diffusion LLM의 prefix KV/FFN 스트리밍 최적화, WIFiV-LPDDR/BRQ-KV/DAT-FFN 코설계로 Jetson에서 에너지 3.79배, 지연 2.88배 개선.
all.relation: H3과 유사. 'KV를 특별하게 다룬다' 아이디어가 유사하지만, block-diffusion이라는 다른 아키텍처 및 전용 하드웨어.
all.gap: block-diffusion vs standard autoregressive; 전용 하드웨어 코설계 vs CPU-only.
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
all.title: Hardware Acceleration of Block-Diffusion LLM for Edge Devices
all.abstract: Single-stream (batch-one) edge inference cannot amortize weight traffic across requests. Full-attention diffusion LLMs recompute the entire sequence at every step; native block diffusion makes completed blocks immutable and exactly cacheable, yet refinement still streams prefix KV and FFN weights. We co-design WIFiV-LPDDR, a wide-I/O LPDDR system for precision-tagged reads, BRQ-KV for a canonical low-rank-plus-INT8-residual prefix with query-dependent per-entry precision, and DAT-FFN for drift-mapped canonical replacement, adjacent-stage-corrected low-bit delta, or cached-state carry while kee

all.what: IMC/NMC/INC를 결합한 하드웨어 및 prefill-decode 분리 소프트웨어 코설계.
all.relation: 메모리 대역폭 벽 해결 전략이지만, ASIC 전용 하드웨어 설계로 CPU-only 환경과 무관.
all.gap: 전용 하드웨어(IMC/NMC) vs CPU-only; 메모리 대역폭 최적화 vs 코어 부족에 따른 연산-통신 경합.
all.title: LLM Inference on IMC-NoC Architecture with Balanced Dataflow and Fine-Grained Parallelism
all.abstract: LLM inference has become an essential service, yet it imposes unprecedented demands on memory bandwidth, computational density, and communication efficiency. While IMC is a promising solution to the memory wall issue, the heterogeneous data dynamicity of LLM requires complementary resources to handle intermediate data generated during run-time. Furthermore, the massive number of parameters in LLM necessitates scale-up architectures where on-chip data movement is often the primary performance bottleneck. This article presents a hardware-software co-design framework that unifies distributed comp

all.what: 생성형 랭킹을 Hungarian algorithm으로 O(1) forward pass에 디코딩.
all.relation: 디코딩 최적화인데, 우리 목표는 prefill/TTFT 최적화. 문제 자체가 다르다.
all.title: hLLM: Single Pass Decoding for Generative Reranking
all.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art generative ranking quality, but the ranking they produce must be decoded, and autoregressive decoding spends one sequential forward pass per emitted token. We observe that the only tokens a ranker must emit are the $N$ ordinal values naming the items in ranked order, and that this narrow, permutation-structured output format admits decoding strategies which are much more efficient than left-to-right generation. all.what: NVFP4 저비트 양자화에서 outlier channel을 low-magnitude와 그룹화하는 PTQ 기법.
all.relation: CPU edge 추론에서 양자화는 관련이 있지만, 모델 전후처리 기법으로 prefill 파이프라인·병렬 구조와 직교.
all.gap: 양자화 기법 vs 파이프라인 구조 및 통신 최적화.
all.title: OCGQuant: Outlier-Companion Grouping for NVFP4 Quantization
all.abstract: NVFP4 is an efficient microscaling format for low-bit inference, but activation outliers can still degrade quantization accuracy within NVFP4 blocks. Within each quantization block, large activations can dominate the block scale, increasing the quantization error of the remaining values sharing the same scale. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods mitigate outlier errors through strategies such as mixed precision, rotation, or residual compensation, but these approaches are either not specifically tailored to NVFP4 or introduce additional computation. In this work, we revisit NVFP4

all.what: KV 캐시 압축 시 정답 근거 제거 감지 후 거부하도록 LoRA 어댑터 학습, hallucination 97% 감소.
all.relation: KV 다루기 문제이지만, 압축-해제 정확도 학습으로 사용자의 'KV 직접 산출' 아이디어와 방향이 다름.
all.gap: KV 압축 정확도 학습 vs KV 재계산을 통한 FLOPs 감소; long-context QA vs 단문 prefill.
all.title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
all.abstract: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not.
